Built against DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer range `>=0.2"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"experience** to the DSH Web UI. Built against DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer range `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The repository is a pnpm monorepo containing two independent runtime plugins and one pure bundle pac"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"epository is a pnpm monorepo containing two independent runtime plugins and one pure bundle package:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Package | Kind | What it does |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| `@jcy2387/dsh-codex-provider` | Runtime plugin | Registers the `openai-codex` provider with ChatGP"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"T OAuth login, proactive token refresh, usage dashboard, proxy-aware networking, and a native Settin"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"gs page. |
| `@jcy2387/dsh-conversation-ui` | Runtime plugin | Adds assistant reveal, auto-expanded "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"thinking, and deliverables while preserving native DSH chat layout and controls. |
| `@jcy2387/dsh-s"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"uite` | Pure bundle | No runtime code — a single profile patch that installs both plugins at once. |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The two plugins are fully decoupled: the Conversation UI works with any model, and the Codex Provide"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"r works with the stock chat UI."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why this suite"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Codex Provider — reliable ChatGPT access without an API key**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **ChatGPT OAuth, both flows.** Browser-based login with device-code fallback. Login failures are c"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"lassified into secret-free, localized reasons (region restrictions, callback port conflicts, token e"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"xchange errors, network issues…) instead of raw stack traces.
- **IPv6 loopback callback bridge.** p"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"i-ai's OAuth listener only binds IPv4; on IPv6-preferred hosts the suite transparently relays the lo"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"opback callback, so login still works.
- **Proactive token refresh.** Access tokens rotate ~5 minute"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"s before expiry with retry backoff; a dead refresh token is detected precisely and surfaces as *reco"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"nnect required* instead of failing mid-stream.
- **Usage dashboard.** Plan (shown under its user-fac"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ing name such as Plus, Pro 5x, or Pro 20x), credits, and primary/secondary rate-limit windows with u"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"sed-percent bars and reset times, fetched from the account-scoped ChatGPT endpoint.
- **Banked rate-"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"limit resets.** View how many resets the account has banked and their earliest expiry, then redeem o"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ne from a confirmation dialog to restore the 5-hour and weekly limit windows.
- **Proxy-aware networ"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"king.** Auto-detects environment and system proxies (macOS / Windows / Linux), routes only OpenAI tr"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"affic through them, keeps loopback direct, and exposes an explicit proxy mode (auto / environment / "},{"id":"p11s14","text":"off).
- **Reliability-first defaults.** SSE transport by default (no partial-output duplication on W"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"ebSocket failure), 5-minute stream idle timeout, configurable retry policy.
- **Native Settings page"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"** at *Plugins → DSH Codex Suite → codex-provider* localized in all eight DSH built-in languages (zh"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"/en/ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt), with live status, and a loopback-only RPC boundary — credentials never leave"},{"id":"p11s18","text":"fr/de/ru/pt), with live status, and a loopback-only RPC boundary — credentials never leave the Host."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Conversation UI — enhancements within native DSH chat**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Native presentation.** DSH owns tool groups, work-details modes, process folding, running status"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", and viewport restoration.

The suite registers `"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"codex-provider` and `conversation-ui` directly; installing their standalone bundles alongside it dec"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lares duplicate loader entry ids and prevents startup. Restart dsh after any bundle-list change."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"When upgrading from the grouped suite, remove overlays targeting `suite-plugins`; configure `codex-p"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rovider` and `conversation-ui` directly. Plugin ids, saved preferences, credentials, and session dat"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"rsation-ui` directly. Plugin ids, saved preferences, credentials, and session data remain unchanged."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. Install the suite (see above) and open the Web UI (`dsh web`).
2. Go to **Plugins → DSH Codex Sui"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"te → codex-provider**, click **Connect**, and choose **Browser login** (or **Device login** on a hea"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"dless/remote machine). Complete the ChatGPT authorization.
3. Back in the chat, pick an `openai-code"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"x` model in the model selector and start talking.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Each runtime plugin ships two halves:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Host half** (Node) — Cordis plugin: provider registration, OAuth lifecycle, networking, settings"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" persistence. Loaded from the package root.
- **Web half** (browser) — React views discovered throug"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"h the `dsh.client` manifest. The Codex Provider contributes the Settings section; the Conversation U"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"I replaces the assistant node view and wraps tool rows."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The halves communicate through two narrow channels: an inline **boot-config global** (`window.__DSH_"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"CONVERSATION_UI_CONFIG__`) injected into the served HTML carries validated plugin config to the brow"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ser, and the **authenticated Connection RPC** carries settings reads/writes back to the Host. Secret"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"s (tokens, proxy URLs) never cross the RPC boundary."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Package-level docs: codex-provider · conversation-ui · suite"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The provider uses pi-ai `1.3.0`, matching the DSH adapter, and the suite builds against the DSH `0.2"},{"id":"p32s2","text":".2-rc.1` closure (cordis `4.1.0`, loader `1.1.0`, schemastery `3.19.0`). The Conversation UI leaves "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"live status and scrolling to DSH 0.2 and uses its localized duration units for completed Turns, incl"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"uding stopped and failed outcomes. Both plugins typecheck, pass their unit suites, and boot in an is"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"olated DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` Web profile: the boot graph serves both client bundles, the Conversation UI "},{"id":"p32s6","text":"boot-config global is injected into the served HTML, and both plugin RPC channels answer through the"},{"id":"p32s7","text":" Connection fence. A Playwright pass over that Web profile then confirmed the browser side end to en"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"d: both plugin pages and both settings cards render, the eight DSH built-in languages switch live, a"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"nd the console stays clean. Restart DSH after replacing an older plugin version."}],"truncated":true}
